record.question: Which Article of the Indian Constitution provides for Right to Education?
record.explanation: Answer D: Article21A. Article 21A guarantees the right to education for children aged six to fourteen. Reference: https://legislative.gov.in/constitution-of-india/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: LDC MPSC Paper-I, February 2025 examination; current affairs interpreted as of paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
